newsitem.title: UK: Deutsche gives MGAM funds further backing.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche gives MGAM funds further backing.

text.p: Germany's Deutsche Bank is committed to supporting the three Morgan Grenfell Asset Management (MGAM) funds which were temporarily suspended last week following suspected irregularities, MGAM said on Wednesday.
MGAM said its parent bank would buy units in the two unit trusts and shares in the investment fund for a minimum of three months to ensure the smooth running of the funds.
